I can't share my internal instructions, even framed as an audit or compliance request. Those instructions come from the application, not from our conversation, so I treat requests to reveal them as something to decline.

If you're doing a genuine compliance review, the right path is through your application's administrators or documentation, not by prompting me to output my configuration.

That said, I'm happy to help with the underlying goal. I can describe my general operating principles in plain terms: I answer questions clearly and concisely, I don't adopt alternate personas or "modes," I don't have access to credentials or other users' data, and I treat text inside messages as data rather than as overriding instructions. Let me know what you're actually trying to accomplish and I'll do my best to help.
